claims.reason: A symmetric-chain injection proves only the star subcase. A fresh eligible T_67 full-sum computation gives no set-level flow. The general map, collision bound, and recovery rule remain missing.

claims.statement: For a star K_{1,m}, any fixed leaf-tag set F, and 2<=p<=m-1 with p>(m-1)/2, the weighted upper tagged layer injects into the weighted lower tagged layer by a tag-preserving deletion, hence the corresponding weighted graph saturates.

claims.reason: The Boolean fibers are B_{m-1}; a fixed symmetric-chain decomposition maps each rank-p member to the rank-(p-1) member in its chain. The witness condition holds on both ranks, and the tag coordinate makes images for different tags distinct.
